newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView ups tech weighting.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView ups tech weighting.

text.p: -- SoundView Financial said it raised its short-term recommended weighting in technology to overweight from average.
-- Market strategist James Townsend said the long-term weighting remains at overweight.
-- Said technology stocks as measured by SoundView Index should outperform broader averages over the next four to five months on both a relative and absolute basis.
-- Said expects SoundView Index to rise 30-40 percent from current level during next four to five months.
